_comment: Battery from one pmset -g batt per refresh: the shell pulls the percentage and the two fields after it (state; detail) plus the power source, and the workflow classifies them. 'AC attached; not charging' is plugged in but holding (Optimized Charging, or a full battery), never 'charging'. A Mac without a battery has no percentage line: the card says so and the menu bar shows nothing.

command: out=$(/usr/bin/pmset -g batt 2>/dev/null); src=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | /usr/bin/sed -n "s/^Now drawing from '\(.*\)'.*/\1/p" | /usr/bin/head -1 | /usr/bin/tr -cd 'A-Za-z '); line=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | /usr/bin/grep -E '[0-9]+%;' | /usr/bin/head -1); pct=$(printf '%s' "$line" | /usr/bin/grep -Eo '[0-9]+%' | /usr/bin/head -1 | /usr/bin/tr -d '%'); [ -n "$pct" ] || pct=null; state=$(printf '%s' "$line" | /usr/bin/cut -s -d';' -f2 | /usr/bin/sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//' | /usr/bin/tr -cd 'A-Za-z '); detail=$(printf '%s' "$line" | /usr/bin/cut -s -d';' -f3 | /usr/bin/sed 's/ *present:.*//;s/^ *//;s/ *$//' | /usr/bin/tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9 :()'); time=$(printf '%s' "$detail" | /usr/bin/grep -Eo '[0-9]+:[0-9][0-9]' | /usr/bin/head -1); printf '{"pct":%s,"source":"%s","state":"%s","detail":"%s","time":"%s"}' "$pct" "$src" "$state" "$detail" "$time"

phase.from: if(not(transforms.has), 'none', if(contains(transforms.detail, 'not charging'), 'notCharging', switch(transforms.st, 'charging', 'charging', 'finishing charge', 'charging', 'charged', 'charged', 'discharging', 'discharging', 'AC attached', 'notCharging', if(eq(transforms.st, ''), if(transforms.onAC, 'notCharging', 'discharging'), 'other'))))

stateText.from: if(transforms.ko, switch(transforms.phase, 'charging', '충전 중', 'notCharging', '충전 안 함', 'charged', '충전 완료', 'discharging', '배터리 사용 중', 'none', '', transforms.st), switch(transforms.phase, 'charging', 'Charging', 'notCharging', 'Not charging', 'charged', 'Charged', 'discharging', 'On battery', 'none', '', transforms.st))

time.from: if(or(eq(coalesce(sources.data.time, ''), ''), eq(sources.data.time, '0:00')), '', if(eq(transforms.phase, 'charging'), sources.data.time, if(eq(transforms.phase, 'discharging'), sources.data.time, '')))

timeLabel.from: if(transforms.ko, if(eq(transforms.phase, 'charging'), '완충까지', '남은 시간'), if(eq(transforms.phase, 'charging'), 'Until full', 'Time left'))

icon.from: if(not(transforms.has), '', if(eq(transforms.phase, 'charging'), 'battery.100percent.bolt', if(gt(transforms.pct, 87), 'battery.100percent', if(gt(transforms.pct, 62), 'battery.75percent', if(gt(transforms.pct, 37), 'battery.50percent', if(gt(transforms.pct, 12), 'battery.25percent', 'battery.0percent'))))))

default.title: No battery
default.subtitle: This Mac runs on power only.

status.label: ${if(transforms.has, concat(string(transforms.pct), '%'), '')}
status.tooltip: ${if(transforms.has, if(transforms.ko, concat('배터리 ', string(transforms.pct), '% — ', transforms.stateText), concat('Battery ', string(transforms.pct), '% — ', transforms.stateText)), if(transforms.ko, '배터리 없음', 'No battery'))}
